title: Firefox Renderer Content Process Spawning Unexpected Child
id: 5f2a1c94-7b6e-4a2d-9e3f-1c8d0a4b7e21
description: A Firefox content/renderer process (firefox.exe with -contentproc) spawns a non-Firefox child, indicating code execution inside the sandboxed renderer consistent with CVE-2026-10702 (IonStack stage 1).
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/07/researchers-show-single-malicious.html
  - https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-54/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/29
tags:
  - attack.t1203
  - attack.t1068
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\firefox.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains: '-contentproc'
  filter_helpers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\plugin-container.exe'
      - '\updater.exe'
      - '\crashreporter.exe'
      - '\pingsender.exe'
      - '\minidump-analyzer.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter_helpers
level: high

| `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - lastTime

2909.sent:
// One HMAC signature reused across >1 (taskID,artifactName) tuple on the Gitea V4 artifact handlers = CVE-2026-58426 boundary-shift forgery.
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where RequestURL has_any ("DownloadArtifact","UploadArtifact")
| where RequestURL has "sig="
| extend Sig = extract(@"[?&]sig=([^&]+)", 1, RequestURL)
| extend TaskID = extract(@"[?&]taskID=([^&]+)", 1, RequestURL)
| extend ArtifactName = extract(@"[?&]artifactName=([^&]+)", 1, RequestURL)
| where isnotempty(Sig)
| extend Tuple = strcat(TaskID, "|", ArtifactName)
| summarize DistinctTuples = dcount(Tuple), Tuples = make_set(Tuple, 10), Methods = make_set(RequestMethod, 5), SrcIPs = make_set(SourceIP, 10), Requests = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Sig, DestinationHostName
| where DistinctTuples > 1   // a valid sig should only ever pair with one fixed tuple
| order by DistinctTuples desc
2909.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count, values(Web.src) as src, values(Web.http_method) as http_method, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web where (Web.url="*DownloadArtifact*" OR Web.url="*UploadArtifact*") Web.url="*sig=*" by Web.url, Web.dest
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| rex field=url "[?&]sig=(?<sig>[^&]+)"
| rex field=url "[?&]taskID=(?<taskID>[^&]+)"
| rex field=url "[?&]artifactName=(?<artifactName>[^&]+)"
| eval tuple=taskID."|".artifactName
| stats dc(tuple) as distinct_tuples, values(tuple) as tuples, values(src) as src, values(http_method) as methods, sum(count) as requests, min(firstTime) as firstTime, max(lastTime) as lastTime by sig, dest
| where distinct_tuples > 1
| sort - distinct_tuples

2978.spl:

       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path

]
